ammonia.reason: Extended proteolysis and amino acid deamination by Penicillium releases NH3 raising pH to ~7.1.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized cow milk and clean Penicillium ripening limit p-cresol/indole/4-ethyloctanoic barnyard compounds.

bitter.reason: Moderate hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin balanced by mold peptidases; mild salt keeps bitterness low.

blue_moldy.reason: Penicillium roqueforti beta-oxidation of octanoic acid to 2-heptanone/2-nonanone defines blue veins but milder than Roquefort.

browning.reason: Moderate protein plus residual galactose/peptides support Maillard but high moisture and low reducing sugar limit browning.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis citrate fermentation yields diacetyl/acetoin retained through short aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Penicillium roqueforti lipase releases butanoic/hexanoic acids; mild lipolysis keeps sweaty punch moderate vs Roquefort.

creaminess.reason: 28.7% fat (~54% FDM) and uncooked, unpressed curd with mold proteolysis create smooth buttery mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: High moisture and fat plus proteolyzed matrix fuse curd grains, limiting dry fracture.

firmness.reason: Unpressed 47% moisture rennet gel with blue piercing gives supple semi-soft body, far softer than hard grana.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol by mold yields light floral background.

fruity.reason: Mold esterases esterify butanoate/hexanoate with secondary alcohols from ketone reduction to ethyl esters.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in C6-C10 goat-associated fatty acids and no goat-milk branched-chain lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Leucine/isoleucine catabolism by starter plus Penicillium yields 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal giving nutty notes.

melt.reason: High pH demineralized casein and high fat-in-dry-matter allow good flow on heating without pasta-filata structure.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Penicillium lipoxygenase oxidation of linoleic acid to 1-octen-3-ol gives mushroom-earthy interior.

oil_off.reason: Moderate free fat from Penicillium lipolysis coalesces on heating but intact protein network retains most oil.

smoky.reason: No smoke exposure or smoked process; no guaiacol/syringol formation.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactate largely consumed by mold and pH 7.09 buffers acetic/lactic sharpness.

stretch.reason: No high-heat stretching/acid demineralization; rennet gel fragments rather than aligning into fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methionine-derived methanethiol/DMDS; pasteurized milk without cooked-curd H2S and no washed-rind flora.

sweet.reason: Deacidification by lactate consumption plus diacetyl/lactones and low sourness enhance sweet perception.

umami.reason: Rennet plus Penicillium aspartyl proteinases release glutamate/aspartate enhancing savory broth taste.
